 Terry Bradshaw set for another FOX NFL Sunday snub with Rob Gronkowski missing
 Terry Bradshaw appears to be set for another snub as FOX Sports travels to Germany for the New England Patriots' clash against the Detroit Lions in Munich, with Rob Gronkowski nowhere to be found
 Add to preferred sources Comments Sport Jarrod Castillo Sports Reporter 18:23 ET, 11 Nov 2026 Updated 18:23 ET, 11 Nov 2026 View 2 Images Terry Bradshaw will be part of FOX Sports' coverage of the NFL games in Germany, though in a way that's different to him (Image: Getty) 
 Terry Bradshaw appears to be set for another snub on FOX NFL Sunday as the network hosts a historic tripleheader.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 For Week 10, FOX Sports will have special pregame coverage before the New England Patriots take on the Detroit Lions in Munich. As usual, the network will air FOX NFL Sunday in two parts: One starting at 9 AM ET to accommodate the German game and the other at 12:30 PM ET.
 That said, the split will mean Bradshaw has to be part of the latter part of FOX NFL Sunday, making it the second week to deal with a snub.
 READ MORE : Dianna Russini left embarrassed as NFL media comeback descends into nightmare READ MORE : Dianna Russini talks about husband as she addresses elephant in the room after Mike Vrabel drama The first block of FOX NFL Sunday will feature Curt Menefee, Michael Strahan and Julian Edelman, presumably discussing the day's many games. In the second block, Bradshaw will join Menefee, Howie Long, Strahan and Jay Glazer, though it appears as if Rob Gronkowski will not be included.
 Gronkowski is typically featured on FOX's NFL coverage, but in Week 10, the former NFL star appears to be completely removed from FOX NFL Sunday and any of the games that day. Joe Davis and Greg Olsen will be joined by Pam Oliver in the Munich game between the Patriots and Lions.
 In the late game between the San Francisco 49ers and Dallas Cowboys, Kevin Burkhardt and Tom Brady will call the game alongside Erin Andrews, Tom Rinaldi and Dean Blandino.
 ‌ 
 View 2 Images Rob Gronkowski seemingly will not be part of FOX Sports' NFL tripleheader (Image: Photo by Paras Griffin/Getty Images) 
 In all, FOX will have six games on its networks: The Patriots-Lions, Minnesota Vikings at the Green Bay Packers, the Houston Texans taking on the Cleveland Browns, the Carolina Panthers facing the New Orleans Saints, the Jacksonville Jaguars playing the Tennessee Titans and the 49ers' late clash against the Cowboys.
 ‌ 
 For Bradshaw, this weekend is the second in as many weeks that he was snubbed in some way. For Veterans Day weekend, FOX aired a two-hour special that combined the FOX NFL Kickoff and FOX NFL Sunday casts, with the shows split between the U.S. Military Academy at West Point, New York, and the U.S. Naval Academy in Annapolis, Maryland.
 Bradshaw was at Annapolis with Charissa Thompson, Glazer and Long, with the quartet standing in front of the academy's Bancroft Hall, surrounded by various service members.
 ‌ 
 During the halftime hits for both the New York Giants-Philadelphia Eagles and Packers and Patriots matchups, only Menefee, Strahan and Charles Woodson were displayed, with the trio settling in West Point. However, Bradshaw and the rest of the Annapolis crew did not appear.
 READ MORE : Troy Aikman's thinly veiled money swipe at Joe Buck picked up by NFL viewers READ MORE : Troy Aikman looks 'absolutely miserable' next to Joe Buck in latest MNF appearance amid ESPN dispute Despite the situation, Bradshaw made the most of his opportunities to needle his coworkers, turning his attention to Woodson and Edelman.
 The 80-year-old called out his colleagues for not wearing ties, with Bradshaw and Long dressing up out of respect.
 “First of all, I’m extremely disappointed in Woody and Julian,” Bradshaw said during the broadcast.
 “They have no respect for the wonderful people there. Howie and I are wearing ties today out of respect for all the wonderful midshipmen. Really, these are wonderful people. You should apologize to kick off the set.”
